business.text: Asian Paints is engaged in the manufacturing, selling, and distribution of paints, coatings, home décor products, bath fittings, modular kitchens, decorative lighting, and uPVC doors and windows. The company generates the vast majority of its revenue through indirect distribution, with sales to dealers or distributors accounting for 99.0% of total sales in FY 2025-26. Additionally, the company provides related services and operates the world's largest home painting service, known as Beautiful Homes Painting Service.

narrative.text: The annual report focuses on formal governance, structural consolidation like the amalgamation of Asian Paints (Polymers), risk frameworks, and major capital expenditures such as proposed paint plants in Madhya Pradesh and the UAE. In contrast, management concalls place stronger emphasis on operational execution, detailing price hikes taken to combat input cost inflation, and highlighting margin expansion alongside strong volume growth. Concalls also frequently discuss tactical growth levers, including retail network additions, Beautiful Home store rollouts, and backward integration projects like the VAM-VAE plant and Fujairah white cement facility. Both sources reflect a shared focus on long-term expansion, while concalls detail near-term profitability dynamics and product innovations.

balance.text: As of 31st March 2026, the company held standalone cash, bank balances, and investments totaling Rs 9,014.60 crores, with group-level liquidity reaching Rs 9,762.11 crores. Against this liquidity, the company reported long-term borrowings of 805.42 crores, with 771.43 crores hypothecated as security for borrowings.

cites.quote: The Company has long-term borrowings of ` 805.42 crores as on 31st March 2026, arising pursuant to the amalgamation of Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, with the Company.

Cash and cash equivalents and other balances with Banks (excluding earmarked balances), current/non-current  term deposits as disclosed in other financial assets, investments in debentures or bonds (including interest  accrued on the same) and mutual funds on a standalone basis as on 31st March 2026, stood at ₹ 9,014.60 crores as against ₹ 4,533.55 crores in the previous financial year.

The Company believes that its liquidity position (₹ 9,014.60 crores as at 31st March 2026 (Previous Year-  ₹ 4,533.55 crores)), anticipated future internally generated funds from operations, and its fully available revolving undrawn credit facility will enable it to meet its future known obligations in the ordinary course of business.
